newsitem.title: CANADA: Falconbridge union on strike - official.
newsitem.headline: Falconbridge union on strike - official.

text.p: Falconbridge Ltd's 1,400 unionized workers at its Sudbury, Ontario operations are on strike after union and company negotiators failed to agree on a new contract, union officials confirmed on Friday.
"The picket lines are set up and everything is organized," Ben Robinson, a member of the Canadian Auto Workers union bargaining committee, said in a telephone interview.
"We were close, but just not quite good enough. There were a few outstanding issues and we were unable to get them settled," Robinson said.
Falconbridge's Sudbury operations last year produced 45,700 tonnes of nickel, 50,000 tonnes of copper and 1,600 tonnes of cobalt, including custom feed.
Falconbridge stock was off 0.40 at 29.20 in light morning turnover of 187,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Friday.
